title: One step of payload replay
statement: Let $x,P,R,O$ be Boolean words and let $p$ be an input-head position among the $|x|+2$ positions. From the live replay configuration with work tape holding $PR$, head at cell $|P|$, and output $O$, one step halts without changing the configuration's tape or output if $R$ is empty. If $R=b::R'$ for a bit $b$, one step leaves the stored word unchanged, advances the head to cell $|P|+1$, appends $b$ to the output, and remains live.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean input x and words P, R, and O
replaced:
Let $p$ and $r$ be Boolean words. One step of the one-tape replay machine from its live
state at cell $|p|$ of the buffer tape holding $p$ followed by $r$ either halts without
writing when $r$ is empty, or, when $r$ starts with a bit $b$, appends $b$ to the output
and advances the head by one, leaving the stored word unchanged.
